title: The Scale plan is generally available | Lumenrail Blog
author: Hana Ito
text: Today the Lumenrail Scale plan leaves beta and is generally available to every customer. Scale costs $349 per month billed annually ($419 billed monthly) and includes 50M events per month, 13 months of data retention and SAML SSO. Additional events are $6 per million. Customers on the Scale beta keep their beta price until their next renewal.
summary: Lumenrail Scale plan GA on Oct 27, 2026: $349/month billed annually, 50M events per month included, 13-month retention, SSO.
keywords: lumenrail scale plan launch pricing price events general availability

title: Pricing | Lumenrail
text: Lumenrail pricing. Starter: $79 per month billed annually, 5M events per month. Scale: $349 per month billed annually ($419 billed monthly), 50M events per month, SAML SSO, 13-month retention. Enterprise: custom pricing and volume. Extra events on Scale cost $6 per million.
keywords: lumenrail pricing plans scale starter enterprise price events

title: Introducing the Scale plan (beta) | Lumenrail Blog
author: Hana Ito
text: We're opening a beta of our new Scale plan for high-volume teams. During the beta, Scale is $299 per month and includes 25M events per month. Pricing will change at general availability.

title: Plans and pricing | Lumenwise
text: Lumenwise (smart lighting control) plans: Home $9 per month, Pro $49 per month, Scale $499 per month for up to 500 fixtures.

title: Lumenrail takes its Scale plan out of beta
author: SaaS News Daily
text: Product analytics startup Lumenrail made its Scale plan generally available this week. The company did not comment on how many customers joined the beta, which launched last November.
